name: ai-mark-lint
summary: Checks in CI that synthetic images, video and audio carry machine-readable AI marks (C2PA, IPTC DigitalSourceType, the GB 45438 AIGC label), judged against EU AI Act art. 50(2), California SB 942 (as amended by AB 853 and SB 1000) and China GB 45438-2025, citing the rule for every finding. Read-only.
author: EasyByte Hub, S. Coop. Mad.
